# StartBox Ventures

> StartBox Ventures is a Marketing & Digital Consultancy based in India, working with businesses in 10+ countries. We're the marketing brain for growing businesses: we diagnose what's broken, plan the fix, and get it done. Every engagement starts with a free diagnosis: we show you your two biggest problems in the first call. 380+ projects and 89+ brands since July 2024.

Ashmita Mishra: Founder, CEO and Chief Strategy Officer. Shivani Tripathi: COO and Chief Technology Officer.
Contact: WhatsApp or call +91 96964 39231, team@startboxventures.in.
Prices: diagnosis call free; Digital Presence Setup from ₹45,000; Go-to-market Strategy from ₹55,000; Personal Branding from ₹40,000; Campaign Manager from ₹40,000; Marketing Partner on request; StartBox for MSME from ₹15,000.
Clients in: India, United Kingdom, United States, United Arab Emirates, Israel, Canada, Netherlands, Italy, Spain, Japan.

## Products
- [Digital Presence Setup](https://startboxventures.in/services#digital-presence): For existing businesses that look scattered online. We set up your business online so customers find you, trust you, and buy, without you wasting money on random fixes. From ₹45,000.
- [Go-to-market Strategy](https://startboxventures.in/services#go-to-market): For founders with an idea, not launched yet. You have the idea. We give you the step-by-step plan to launch it and start selling. From ₹55,000.
- [Personal Branding](https://startboxventures.in/services#personal-branding): For b2B founders, founders becoming coaches or speakers, and coaches. Your name should open doors before your pitch does. We build the personal brand that makes people trust you first. From ₹40,000.
- [Campaign Manager](https://startboxventures.in/services#campaign-manager): For one sale, offer or launch. One campaign, planned and managed end to end. From ₹40,000.
- [Marketing Partner](https://startboxventures.in/services#marketing-partner): For clients who've worked with us. Every marketing decision runs through us before money is spent. On request.
- [StartBox for MSME](https://startboxventures.in/msme): We help businesses grow online by telling them exactly what to fix, and then fixing it. Monthly handling, website, copywriting, content strategy, video editing and videography, for businesses in Gujarat and Maharashtra. From ₹15,000.

## Insights
- [The question nobody asks before selling you marketing](https://startboxventures.in/insights/the-question-nobody-asks): Why StartBox Ventures was built around one habit most agencies skip: finding out what is actually wrong before recommending anything. The story behind 'we diagnose before we prescribe'.
- [The AI tools worth using in 2026, and what to use them for](https://startboxventures.in/insights/ai-tools-for-business-2026): ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, Canva and Meta's ad tools: which AI tools business owners actually use in 2026, what each is good for, and where to be careful.
- [AI's real risks for business owners: deepfakes, made-up facts and new rules](https://startboxventures.in/insights/ai-risks-for-business): The AI concerns that matter to brands and marketers: deepfakes of founders, AI that invents facts, India's 2026 AI labelling rules and the DPDP data rules. What happened, and what to do.
- [What the biggest acquisitions of the last two years teach small business owners](https://startboxventures.in/insights/what-acquisitions-teach-small-business): HUL bought Minimalist, ITC bought 24 Mantra and Prasuma, Reliance and Disney formed JioStar. What buyers actually paid for, and how to build those things into your own business.
- [How AI search changes the way customers find your business](https://startboxventures.in/insights/google-ai-mode-search-2026): Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode now answer questions before anyone clicks. What that means for your website traffic, and six things to do so AI search recommends your business.
- [Meta wants to make your ads for you. Should you let it?](https://startboxventures.in/insights/meta-automated-ads-2026): Meta is moving towards fully AI-made ads: upload a product and a budget, and its AI does the rest. What that means for small businesses, where it works, and where it quietly wastes money.
- [Why more ads won't fix falling sales](https://startboxventures.in/insights/why-more-ads-wont-fix-sales): Running Meta or Google ads but sales aren't going up? Here is where the money usually leaks, and the five checks to make before you increase your ad budget.
- [What a free diagnosis should show you before you spend on marketing](https://startboxventures.in/insights/what-a-business-audit-covers): Before you pay for any marketing, someone should tell you what is actually wrong. Here is what a useful first diagnosis looks at, what you should leave with, and the warning signs.
- [Google Business Profile: a checklist for local businesses](https://startboxventures.in/insights/google-business-profile-checklist): A practical Google Business Profile checklist for shops, clinics, restaurants and service businesses: get found on Google Maps, earn more reviews, and turn views into calls.
- [What is a sales funnel? A plain-English guide for business owners](https://startboxventures.in/insights/sales-funnel-guide): A sales funnel is the path that turns someone who sees you into someone who pays. A plain-English guide with examples for D2C brands, coaches and service businesses.
- [Your website gets visits but no enquiries: seven things to check](https://startboxventures.in/insights/website-no-enquiries): If your business website gets traffic but no calls, WhatsApp messages or form fills, check these seven things first. A practical list for business owners.
